This page is also available as Markdown . Copy On this page Airdrop & Reward 💎 Airdrop Pioneer Season Airdrop Pioneer Season Note: The Pioneer Season concluded on March 25 at 23:59 (UTC). Upon KiloEx successfully becoming the first Perpetual DEX on opBNB, we are excited to officially launch the Points Airdrop Program. The Program will be effective across all of KiloEx's mainnets , including BNBChain, opBNB and Manta. To earn more points, you will receive more airdrops when $KILO tokens are issued. Join KiloEx early to accumulate more points! Ways to Earn Points Name Definition Specific Rules Check-in Points (Waiting Points System) Click 'Check-in' on the Points Airdrop page to earn points daily. Automatically check in if you engage in trading on the same day. No need to click. Consecutive check-ins progressively increase points: Earn 1 point on the first day, 2 points on the second day, and so on up to 7 points on the seventh day, accumulating a total of 28 points after 7 days. * Restart counting from the first day if check-ins are interrupted. Trading Points Points are earned for all trades conducted on KiloEx's mainnet. Different weighting factors apply during different time periods. The Airdrop Points earned per 1000 USDT traded will also be reduced by 30% to 24.5 points. Earn Points Points are earned for all deposits made on KiloEx's mainnet. Different weighting factors apply during different time periods. Deposits made before October 23, 2023: (Amount of USDT deposited or withdrawn * Cumulative Hours in Vault / 24) * 0.05 = Points Earned Deposits made after October 23, 2023: (Amount of USDT deposited or withdrawn * Cumulative Hours in Vault / 24) * 0.025 = Points Earned Deposits made after February 1, 2024: (Amount of USDT deposited or withdrawn * Cumulative Hours in Vault / 24) * 0.0125 = Points Earned *As the total platform deposit volume increases, the weighting factor may be further adjusted downward. Referral Points Points Referrers earn additional points for the points generated by their referrals. The Referers receive an additional 15% (level 1) to 25% (level 9) of the points generated after the invitee binds the invitation code. *Coefficient adjustments will be made based on actual circumstances in the future. OAT Points Participate in various activities and contribute to KiloEx's development to earn OAT. Specific rewards for what OAT points can earn are detailed in the OAT List table. On July 17, 2024, at 00:00:00 (UTC), KiloEx will take a snapshot of all wallet addresses on the platform for Airdrop Genesis Season: All points earned by users and their acquisition details have been recorded in the snapshot. Old Airdrop Plan: The airdrop ratio is 10%, a total of 100 million Kilo tokens.From mainnet launch to TGE, 2% (20 million tokens) will be airdropped during the incentive period;From TGE to 90 days after TGE, 2% (20 million tokens) will be airdropped during the incentive period;From 90 days to 180 days after TGE, 2% (20 million tokens) will be airdropped during the incentive period;From 180 days to 270 days after TGE, 2% (20 million tokens) will be airdropped during the incentive period;From 270 days to 360 days after TGE, 2% (20 million tokens) will be airdropped during the incentive period. New airdrop plan: Airdrop ratio: 10%, total 100 million Kilo token. Airdrop Genesis Season mainnet will end at 00:00:00 on July 17(UTC), 4% (40 million tokens) of the incentivized actions will be airdropped during the Token Generation Event From 00:00:01 on July 17(UTC) to TGE (Airdrop Pioneer Season) and from TGE to 180 days post-TGE, a total of 6% (60 million tokens) of the incentivized actions will be airdropped. As KiloEx is currently in discussions with major exchanges for listing, the exact TGE time is not yet determined, so the airdrop quantity for the Pioneer Season cannot be determined. The platform will continue to distribute airdrop tokens based on user actions. Display of Points On the Points Airdrop page, you will see details of various points and your daily, weekly, and overall rankings. Anti-Cheating Mechanism The team will enforce strict rules and employ advanced technology to remove cheating accounts. Accounts identified as cheating will be permanently ineligible to receive any KiloEx rewards or airdrops. Warning Against Wash Trading KiloEx strictly prohibits wash trading on our platform. Wash trading is the illegal practice of entering buy and sell orders simultaneously to artificially inflate trading volumes. If user accounts are found to be intentionally wash trading, they risk losing eligibility for airdrops and other rewards programs. Offending accounts also risk being banned or restricted from trading activities on KiloEx. We have surveillance measures in place to detect and deter potential wash trading. By trading on KiloEx, you agree not to engage in artificial volume inflation schemes or any other market manipulation tactics. Those who violate this policy do so at their own risk. Please trade responsibly. Report any suspicious activity to our customer support team. Together, we can build a healthy trading ecosystem at KiloEx. Restricted Area Note that we may not make all of the Services available in all markets and jurisdictions, and may restrict or prohibit use of all or a portion of the Services from Restricted Locations, which at this time include Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Crimea, Bangladesh, Bolivia, Donetsk, Luhansk, Malta and China Mainland. Incentive Adjustment Mechanism The team will reasonably adjust incentive plans based on market conditions, project status, and user feedback.
